Prometheus2Heraclitus collection maintenance

Read MODEL.md before maintaining this repository. It owns collection scope, independent member ownership, language, source limits, and publication boundaries. The root README editions introduce the actual collection members. Keep English and Chinese reader editions semantically aligned.

Each Skill under skills/ owns its complete package and supporting resources. For Yinyang, read its MODEL.md and its AGENTS.md before editing its philosophical account or formation method. Yinyang's references/docs/ and references/diagrams/ are package accessories, not root collections or independent Skills. Other actual Skills retain their specialist purpose and methods.

Keep changes within the affected owner. Verify local links and public source locators after relocation; preserve licenses, separate rights, third-party notices, executable modes, and assets. Do not invent demonstration members, copy a private portrait, or retrieve personal material just to maintain this public repository. Model-facing maintenance prose remains English.

website/ is a complete generated snapshot of an exact committed native Site revision, with the QA-only exclusions recorded in website/SOURCE.json. Do not edit its copies directly. Read MODEL.md's website publication workflow; use scripts/sync-website.py to apply and check committed source coverage, bytes and modes. Preserve tracked dist/ static sources and all rights notices. The website presents materials and package introductions; all source downloads use GitHub directories or its native repository ZIP. Do not add separate website package ZIP generation or Release/tag maintenance.
